fruits.extendedStory: Trading went on here from 1350. Fire gutted the hall in 1555, and the rebuild is what you see today. Look along the top edge of the building. The grotesque stone heads up there are the maszkarony, designed by the Italian sculptor Santi Gucci. Giammaria Mosca worked on the building too.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Gehandelt wurde hier schon ab 1350. 1555 fraß ein Brand die Halle aus, und was du heute siehst, ist der Wiederaufbau. Schau die obere Kante entlang. Die grotesken Steinköpfe dort oben heißen maszkarony und stammen vom italienischen Bildhauer Santi Gucci. Auch Giammaria Mosca arbeitete an dem Bau mit.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Trading went on here from 1350. Fire gutted the hall in 1555, and the rebuild is what you see today. Look along the top edge of the building. The grotesque stone heads up there are the maszkarony, designed by the Italian sculptor Santi Gucci. Giammaria Mosca worked on the building too.

localizedStory.de: 1555 brannte die Tuchhalle aus; zurück kam sie mit steinernen Fratzen am Dachrand.
localizedStory.en: Fire gutted the Cloth Hall in 1555, and it came back with carved heads along its roofline.

fruits.name: Sukiennice
fruits.story: Fire gutted the Cloth Hall in 1555, and it came back with carved heads along its roofline.

fruits.extendedStory: The style is Brick Gothic. That means the pointed arches of Gothic, built in brick instead of stone. Work here goes back to 1223. The church carries the name of Mary. It reaches 81 metres, and you will see it long before you reach the square.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Stil heißt Backsteingotik. Das sind die Spitzbögen der Gotik, nur in Ziegel statt in Stein gebaut. Die Arbeit hier reicht bis 1223 zurück. Die Kirche trägt den Namen Marias. Sie kommt auf 81 Meter, und du siehst sie lange, bevor du den Platz erreichst.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The style is Brick Gothic. That means the pointed arches of Gothic, built in brick instead of stone. Work here goes back to 1223. The church carries the name of Mary. It reaches 81 metres, and you will see it long before you reach the square.

localizedStory.de: Krakaus Backsteinbasilika ragt 81 Meter über den Plac Mariacki.
localizedStory.en: Kraków's brick basilica rises 81 metres above Plac Mariacki.

fruits.name: Bazylika Wniebowzięcia Najświętszej Maryi Panny
fruits.story: Kraków's brick basilica rises 81 metres above Plac Mariacki.

fruits.extendedStory: City documents name this gate already in 1307. Since the Middle Ages it was the main one of the seven ways into Kraków. It stands 34.5 metres to the ball on its helm. From here the kings rode the length of the city and up to Wawel. The Barbakan covers the approach a few steps further out.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Städtische Urkunden nennen dieses Tor schon 1307. Seit dem Mittelalter war es das Haupttor unter den sieben Wegen in die Stadt. Bis zur Kugel auf der Haube misst es 34,5 Meter. Von hier zogen die Könige quer durch die Stadt hinauf zum Wawel. Ein paar Schritte weiter draußen deckt der Barbakan den Zugang.
localizedExtendedStory.en: City documents name this gate already in 1307. Since the Middle Ages it was the main one of the seven ways into Kraków. It stands 34.5 metres to the ball on its helm. From here the kings rode the length of the city and up to Wawel. The Barbakan covers the approach a few steps further out.

localizedStory.de: An diesem Tor begann der Königsweg zum Wawel. Es war das Haupttor unter sieben.
localizedStory.en: The royal road to Wawel began at this gate, the main one of seven.

fruits.name: Brama Floriańska
fruits.story: The royal road to Wawel began at this gate, the main one of seven.

fruits.extendedStory: The tower is Gothic: pointed arches, tall narrow windows, height for its own sake. It has stood here since 1400. Walk right up to the base and look out across the square from its foot. From there the whole of Rynek Główny opens out in front of you.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Turm ist gotisch gebaut: Spitzbögen, hohe schmale Fenster, Höhe um der Höhe willen. Seit 1400 steht er hier. Geh ganz an den Fuß heran und schau von dort über den Platz. Von hier öffnet sich der Rynek Główny in voller Breite vor dir.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The tower is Gothic: pointed arches, tall narrow windows, height for its own sake. It has stood here since 1400. Walk right up to the base and look out across the square from its foot. From there the whole of Rynek Główny opens out in front of you.

localizedStory.de: Dieser gotische Turm steht seit 1400 am Marktplatz.
localizedStory.en: This Gothic tower has stood on the market square since 1400.

fruits.name: Wieża Ratuszowa
fruits.story: This Gothic tower has stood on the market square since 1400.

fruits.extendedStory: Casimir the Third, called the Great, commissioned the castle. Francesco Fiorentino worked on it later. Building on this hill goes back as far as 1001. Stand in the arcaded courtyard and look up at the galleries running round you. The cathedral is a few steps away on the same ground.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Kasimir III., genannt der Große, gab das Schloss in Auftrag. Francesco Fiorentino arbeitete später daran. Gebaut wird auf diesem Hügel schon seit 1001. Stell dich in den Arkadenhof und schau an den Galerien hinauf. Die Kathedrale steht ein paar Schritte weiter auf demselben Grund.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Casimir the Third, called the Great, commissioned the castle. Francesco Fiorentino worked on it later. Building on this hill goes back as far as 1001. Stand in the arcaded courtyard and look up at the galleries running round you. The cathedral is a few steps away on the same ground.

localizedStory.de: Kasimir der Große ließ dieses Schloss bauen; auf dem Hügel steht seit 1001 eines.
localizedStory.en: Casimir the Great commissioned this castle, and the hill has carried one since 1001.

fruits.name: Zamek Królewski na Wawelu
fruits.story: Casimir the Great commissioned this castle, and the hill has carried one since 1001.

fruits.extendedStory: Building on this spot goes back to 1020. What stands now is Gothic, with later work by Giovanni Battista Trevano. The cathedral is named for Stanislaus of Szczepanów. The royal castle stands right beside it on the same hill.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Gebaut wird an dieser Stelle seit 1020. Was heute steht, ist gotisch, mit späterer Arbeit von Giovanni Battista Trevano. Benannt ist die Kathedrale nach Stanislaus von Szczepanów. Das Königsschloss steht gleich daneben auf demselben Hügel.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Building on this spot goes back to 1020. What stands now is Gothic, with later work by Giovanni Battista Trevano. The cathedral is named for Stanislaus of Szczepanów. The royal castle stands right beside it on the same hill.

localizedStory.de: Die Kathedrale auf dem Wawel geht auf 1020 zurück und trägt den Namen des heiligen Stanislaus.
localizedStory.en: The cathedral on Wawel goes back to 1020 and carries the name of Saint Stanislaus.

fruits.name: Bazylika archikatedralna Świętych Stanisława i Wacława
fruits.story: The cathedral on Wawel goes back to 1020 and carries the name of Saint Stanislaus.

fruits.extendedStory: Count the lanes as you walk the edge. Three of them leave each side. That is what a planned town looks like. The plan was drawn in 1257, when Kraków took its charter under Magdeburg law. Nothing here grew by accident. The Cloth Hall sits in the middle of all that open ground.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Zähl die Gassen, während du am Rand entlanggehst. Aus jeder Seite führen drei hinaus. So sieht eine geplante Stadt aus. Der Plan entstand 1257, als Kraków sein Stadtrecht nach Magdeburger Recht erhielt. Hier ist nichts zufällig gewachsen. Mitten auf der freien Fläche steht die Tuchhalle.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Count the lanes as you walk the edge. Three of them leave each side. That is what a planned town looks like. The plan was drawn in 1257, when Kraków took its charter under Magdeburg law. Nothing here grew by accident. The Cloth Hall sits in the middle of all that open ground.

localizedStory.de: Kraków legte diesen Platz 1257 an; seine Seiten messen etwas über 200 Meter.
localizedStory.en: Kraków set this square out in 1257, and its sides run a little over 200 metres.

fruits.name: Rynek Główny
fruits.story: Kraków set this square out in 1257, and its sides run a little over 200 metres.

fruits.extendedStory: The Barbakan is Gothic work from 1498. It stands outside the line of the wall, in front of the Floriańska Gate. Walk around the outside and you can read the shape: a drum, with the gate behind it. Anyone heading into the city had to come past it.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Barbakan ist gotische Arbeit von 1498. Er steht außerhalb der Mauerlinie, vor der Brama Floriańska. Geh außen um ihn herum, dann liest du die Form ab: eine Trommel, und dahinter das Tor. Wer in die Stadt wollte, kam zuerst hier vorbei.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The Barbakan is Gothic work from 1498. It stands outside the line of the wall, in front of the Floriańska Gate. Walk around the outside and you can read the shape: a drum, with the gate behind it. Anyone heading into the city had to come past it.

localizedStory.de: Diese runde Festung entstand 1498, draußen vor dem Stadttor.
localizedStory.en: This round fort went up in 1498, outside the city gate.

fruits.name: Barbakan
fruits.story: This round fort went up in 1498, outside the city gate.

fruits.extendedStory: In 1400 King Władysław Jagiełło handed the university a townhouse he had bought from a Kraków alderman. That house grew into this building, the oldest university building in Poland. The work is Gothic. Step into the courtyard and the galleries run right around you.

localizedExtendedStory.de: 1400 übergab König Władysław Jagiełło der Universität ein Haus, das er einem Krakauer Schöffen abgekauft hatte. Aus diesem Haus wuchs der Bau, in dem du stehst: das älteste Universitätsgebäude Polens. Die Arbeit ist gotisch. Tritt in den Hof, und die Galerien laufen rundum an dir vorbei.
localizedExtendedStory.en: In 1400 King Władysław Jagiełło handed the university a townhouse he had bought from a Kraków alderman. That house grew into this building, the oldest university building in Poland. The work is Gothic. Step into the courtyard and the galleries run right around you.

localizedStory.de: Das ist das älteste Universitätsgebäude Polens, 1400 der Universität übergeben.
localizedStory.en: This is the oldest university building in Poland, handed to the university in 1400.

fruits.name: Collegium Maius
fruits.story: This is the oldest university building in Poland, handed to the university in 1400.
